title: Story premise ENT027: The Painting Nobody Can See Whole
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (cooperation). Hook: The river stops at every border. Takeaway/theme: Shared interfaces do not require identical styles.
description: Four artists each work behind a screen on one section of a mural, and their incompatible horizons initially miss at every seam. They exchange tiny edge samples, align only the boundaries, and reveal four distinct styles connected by one continuous river.
